title: A Modified Approach for Morbid Obese With Gynecologic Cancer
brief_summary: Comparing standard midline approach with the modified approach in management of morbid obese patients with gynecologic cancers.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Resectable (ovarian, endometrial, cervical) cancers.
2. Anaesthetically fit (ASA 1 and 2).
3. Abdominal pannus below symphysis pubis.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Non resectable gynecologic cancer.
2. Unfit patients.
3. Patients who refuse to share in the trial.
condition: Malignant Neoplasm of Cervix, Endometrium and Ovary
